confidence_notes: Cotopaxi is treated as the Cotopaxi Province/volcano area, using nearby Latacunga price indexes as a proxy; Expatistan flags its small sample as unreliable. Food and drink anchors are directional. The wine-glass estimate is inferred from local beer and bottle-of-wine levels. Accommodation anchors are holistic regional estimates without live accommodation research.
comparable_city_reasoning: Nearby Latacunga, the Cotopaxi provincial capital, is the regional price proxy; mountain-area lodging may vary substantially by location and season.
